nameEn: Manufacture of engines and turbines, except aircraft, vehicle and cycle engines
description: This class includes the manufacture of engines and turbines, except aircraft propulsion engines, motor vehicle engines and motorcycle engines.
includes: manufacture of internal combustion piston engines, except motor vehicle and aircraft engines
manufacture of pistons, piston rings, carburettors and such for all engines
manufacture of inlet and exhaust valves for internal combustion engines
manufacture of steam engines and turbines
manufacture of hydraulic turbines and water wheels
manufacture of gas turbines, except turbojets and turboprops for aircraft propulsion
manufacture of parts for engines: crankshafts, camshafts, valves, pistons, piston rings, carburettors, inlet and exhaust manifolds
excludes: manufacture of turbojets and turboprops for aircraft propulsion, see 3030
manufacture of motor vehicle engines, see 2910
manufacture of engines for motorcycles, see 3091
